title: PARH-OSSM: video-based respiratory rate estimation via reliability-weighted multichannel state-space fusion
description: Code of the article "Video-Based Respiratory Rate Estimation via Reliability-Weighted Multichannel State-Space Fusion" (Scientific Reports): the nine video-motion observations of the chest and upper torso, the PARH-OSSM multichannel oscillator state-space filter, its comparison methods, and the scripts that produce every reported table and figure on COHFACE and MAHNOB-HCI. The OF, DoF, and P1D observation operators originate in resPyre (https://github.com/phuselab/resPyre, GPL-3.0). The COHFACE and MAHNOB-HCI recordings are not redistributed.
